text_en: China's August gasoline exports were 700,000 tons, down 17.5% year-on-year; cumulative gasoline exports from January to August were 2.42 million tons, down 57.4% year-on-year. August aviation kerosene exports were 2.55 million tons, up 41.4% year-on-year; cumulative aviation kerosene exports from January to August were 11.76 million tons, down 14.4% year-on-year. August diesel exports were 1.33 million tons, up 42.1% year-on-year; cumulative diesel exports from January to August were 4.84 million tons, up 5.9% year-on-year. August refined oil imports were 2.25 million tons, down 32.8% year-on-year; cumulative refined oil imports from January to August were 22.15 million tons, down 17.1% year-on-year. August naphtha imports were 700,000 tons, down 55.2% year-on-year; cumulative naphtha imports from January to August were 8.41 million tons, down 22.4% year-on-year.
